findings.title: Leader straps still bill twice, and the CN-A-LEADER strap points sit 1.03 in. off the leader's centreline

evidence.measured: takeoff.json hardware: 6 x 'SS316-STANDOFF-STRAP #13' (pipe strap, 'sized on pipe OUTER diameter', the old 4 in round) from CN-A-LEADER-W1..E3, AND cladding_trim 58110XX '4 in downspout strap' count 6 for the same two leaders: 12 straps for 2 leaders (3 each). The strap points are authored at x = -8.77 in. (W) / 36 ft + 8.77 in. (E) ('trough mid-width'), but the resolved leader solid TR-RF-LEADER-W spans x -11.555..-8.055 (centre -9.805) and -E 440.055..443.555: the points are 1.035 in. inboard of the leader centreline (0.7 in. inside its inner face). The leader's inner face stands 0.805 in. off the PBR rib crowns (cladding face -7.25), 2.05 in. off the pan, so the standoff strap bridges a 0.8-2.05 in. gap for a 4 x 3-1/2 rectangular section, not a round pipe.
evidence.expected: One strap product per leader station: either the Metal Sales 4 in downspout strap 58110XX (PBR p.14; wall-hung over the pan) or a stainless standoff strap sized to a 4 x 3-1/2 rectangle, not both; strap points on the leader's centreline.
evidence.method: Python: resolve; [s for s in model.solids if s.tag=='TR-RF-LEADER-W'] outline x in inches (probe E1/p4.py); read plan/mep_electrical.py _LEADER_X_W; baseline takeoff.json hardware rows with part_number 'SS316-STANDOFF-STRAP #13' (count 6) and cladding_trim part 58110XX (count 6).

findings.title: R806.2 inputs: the 23.4 in2/ft Profile Vent rating has no vendored source and the margin is quoted inconsistently; the 6.48 in2/LF soffit rating is for the full 16 in. aluminium panel the house rips to 13.625 in.

evidence.measured: baseline checks.json: R806.2 'PASS 873 in2 over 576 sf (>= 1/150 = 553 in2)' = 562 ridge (23.4 x 24.0 ft) + 311 soffit (6.48 x 48 LF). metal_trim_kit.md:191/335 and plans/TODO.md:262 state the pass as '562 vs 553 / by 9 sq in', which omits the intake and understates the margin (320 in2). Source: SFS ProfileVent sheet 05/2024 is cited but not in notes/sources. WebFetch profilevent.com/our-products/hip-ridgevent: 'Net Free Area of 23.4 sq. in. per linear foot of Hip & RidgeVent' (the 1x2 / 1x3 / 1.5x3 roll product); profilevent.com/our-products/the-ridgevent: shingle RidgeVent 17 in2/lf; distributor listings (3/4 GrandRib, 5-V) read ~23.3, R-panel ~31.7, Delta Rib ~30.9. So 23.4 may be the right order for a 1 in. rib, but the one public 23.4 belongs to a different product. If the rating were per strip (halved, 11.7/ft) the check still passes: 281 + 311 = 592 >= 553. Soffit: Gibraltar's 6.48 in2/LF is the Home Depot listing for the 16 in. x 12 ft black aluminium 4PVS16-BL; garage.py cuts the panel to the 13.625 in. overhang (5.5 in2/LF if proportional: 264 in2). Intake share is 311/873 = 36% and exhaust 64%, outside the 40-50% upper split, so the 1/150 base ratio governs (the check uses it).
evidence.expected: A cut sheet for the Image II 16 in. Profile Vent giving NFA per foot and basis; the soffit NFA for the cut width; the margin stated as the check states it.
evidence.method: pdftotext of notes/sources shows no SFS/ProfileVent sheet; checks.json filter check_id code.R806_2_attic_ventilation; WebFetch profilevent.com pages (2026-11-05); grep soffit_nfva_in2_per_ft plan/storeys/garage.py.

findings.source: profilevent.com Hip & RidgeVent page; Gibraltar 4PVS16 listing; houses/catlin/notes/metal_trim_kit.md 'Supplier confirmation' item 1
findings.proposed_fix: Vendor the SFS sheet into notes/sources; restate the margin in TODO and metal_trim_kit.md as 873 vs 553; note the intake rating is for a 16 in. panel. No geometry.
